messages:
dmitri: Heads-up: after today's kernel-router + autobatch merge I'm seeing memory spikes on long-ctx perf runs, and a couple OOMs in CI. Repro locally with seqlen=4096. Logs show aggressive slab rebalance during KV handoff.
caroline: Repro'd on my laptop (A100). Fragmentation ratio jumps from 1.08 -> 1.44 under steady load. Heaplet heatmap shows a crowding of small live slabs. :thinking_face:
ali: Stack trace points at kv_rebalance_scan() called from autobatch handoff path. There's an O(n) scan that touches many slabs and then triggers small allocs that never coalesce.
jen: eng-ci-bot posted the CI failure: https://ci.internal/runs/8423 - memory regression +12% p99 on kv-heavy longctx test.
eng-ci-bot: perf-ci: job 8423 failed. Regression detected: mem.p99 +12% vs baseline. Artifacts uploaded: s3://perf/8423/artifacts.tar.gz
dmitri: I'm bisecting now. Suspect window: merge range 0a1b2c..d3e4f5 which included both kernel-selection tweak and "slab rebalance on handoff" commit. If we isolate the rebalance it reproduces.
caroline: Quick local bisect narrows to commit 0f9e7c4 (kv: hot-slab rebalance + stride allocator change). If I revert that commit, mem profile looks like baseline.
ali: Can you paste the revert steps?
dmitri: Sure: `git revert --no-edit 0f9e7c4 --no-commit`
Then run:```./tools/run_longctx_perf.sh --model llama --seq 4096 --iters 50 --workers 8```
caroline: perf top snippet after repro:
```
  48.2% kv_alloc_hotpath
  18.4% stride_allocator_lock
  12.3% kv_rebalance_scan
  7.1% memcpy
```
ali: Looks like rebalance scanning + allocator lock contention is the root. Also sequence-length sensitivity: seq<=512 no issue; between 1024-2048 we start to see p95 increase; >=4096 triggers OOMs on smaller nodes.
jen: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) gate the rebalance behind avg_seqlen threshold, 2) increase autobatch handoff delay from 2ms -> 8ms to reduce churn, 3) add CI perf guard for seqlen=4096. I'll prepare a PR with the gating flag.
dmitri: We should also hold rollout of the merge until we have either a revert or the gated fix. @oncall-sre please flag the rollout hold and add a rollback playbook. :eyes:
oncall-sre: Acknowledged. Putting rollout on hold and notifying deployments. Created incident tracker: https://infra/incidents/RED-2763
jen: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3912 (WIP) — it adds `--rebalance-threshold-avg-seq` config and unit tests + perf job.
eng-ci-bot: Issue created: #9876 "kv rebalance -> mem regression on longctx". Perf job seqlen=4096 added to nightly.
dmitri: Plan: (a) if perf CI shows >8% mem regression on next run, revert 0f9e7c4 immediately; (b) land gated fix next; (c) refactor rebalance to avoid full-scan (target O(k) scanning).
caroline: I'll run a baseline vs patched comparison and post numbers here in ~45m. If anyone wants to reproduce faster I can share a condensed repro script.
jen: Thanks all — ping me if you need a quick revert PR. :thumbsup:
